title: POS System
content: Comprehensive Point of Sale system for salon and retail businesses: appointment scheduling, waiting list, customer management, check-in and receipt printing.
description: Worked on a comprehensive Point of Sale (POS) system designed for salon and retail businesses, covering daily operational workflows such as appointment scheduling, customer management, waiting lists, check-in, ticket processing, payment, portal and receipt printing.
responsibilities: Developed, enhanced, and maintained features based on business requirements, merchant requests, and operational needs.
Took primary responsibility for key modules including Appointment Scheduling, Waiting List, Customer Management, Portal and Check-in.
Implemented feature improvements and updates based on feedback from the QC/QA team.
Investigated and resolved bugs and production issues reported by merchants during daily usage.
Supported other modules such as Ticket Management and Receipt Printing.
Collaborated with team members, QC/QA, and stakeholders to analyze requirements and improve features.
Proposed technical and functional improvements to enhance usability, performance, and UX.

title: Booking Online

Fixed bugs and improved the user interface and booking workflow.

Collaborated with the team to improve existing booking functionalities and user flows.
